gloss: being bad at getting along in the world; social ineptness

definitions.gloss: being bad at getting along in the world; social ineptness; poor life skills
definitions.explanation: The quality of being unskilled at navigating social relationships, workplace politics, or the practical demands of adult life.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}だ。
examples.english: He's bad at getting along in the world.

examples.japanese: {正直|しょうじき}すぎて{世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}なところがある。
examples.english: He's so honest that he can be bad at navigating social situations.

examples.japanese: {世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}でも、{実力|じつりょく}があれば{認|みと}められることもある。
examples.english: Even if you're socially inept, you can be recognized if you have real ability.

notes:
Composed of {世渡|よわた}り (getting along in the world; making one's way through life) + {下手|べた} (unskilled at). Implies someone who is too honest, awkward, or principled to play social games effectively. Often used with a degree of sympathy or self-deprecation, not purely as criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}な{人|ひと}: a socially inept person
- {世渡|よわた}りが{下手|へた}: to be bad at navigating the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}: skilled at getting along in the world — the opposite; someone who smoothly navigates social and professional life
- {不器用|ぶきよう}: clumsy; awkward — broader; can refer to physical or social clumsiness
- {要領|ようりょう}が{悪|わる}い: inefficient; awkward at handling things — describes poor practical judgment more than social skills
